title: Your Way Out | Extended Cut
description:
Game not over.
It’s time to take back control.
Presenting “Your Way Out,” the extended cut.

Learn more at www.coinbase.com

asr.full_text: This is for real. Finally. It's a new place! Come on, we gotta get out of here, so we can kill those zombies! You're getting there, Wily. Well. Watch it could swing. Honey, ooh thanks for the change. Welcome player 3984, would you like to get in line? Yes What's the matter with you? Whoosh, whoo hooo! Whoosh, whoo hooo! Whether I'm right Where are you going? The wrong way goes over. The wrong way goes about. Whether I find a place in this world or never belong that just so happens Or somebody else, if I'm not right for me I gotta be free I just gotta be free Daring to try to do it or die I gotta be me

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it is primarily a stylized, game-like narrative about players, escape, crowds, and queues rather than an observable financial solicitation. Coinbase branding and a website appear, but the content is described as informational and expressly says it is not investment advice. The request to subscribe is ordinary channel engagement, and no required payment, credential disclosure, investment participation, deceptive return promise, or transaction outcome is established.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The company's website invitation and closing brand display make promotion of a service the main commercial context; the sampled scenes present a game-like narrative rather than a specific purchase or investment participation flow.

evidence.observation: The description directs viewers to the company's website for more information.
The closing frame displays the Coinbase wordmark.
A character is presented with a player number and game-style attribute bars.
A crowd stands in a roped queue beneath a WAIT HERE sign.
